description: This file contains UI test cases for the BookmarksScreen composable in an Android Jetpack Compose app. It tests loading states, displaying bookmarks, removing bookmarks, empty states, and lifecycle interactions.

classes.name: BookmarksScreenTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying different UI states and interactions of the BookmarksScreen composable.

methods.name: loading_showsLoadingSpinner
methods.description: Tests that the loading spinner is visible when loading.

methods.name: feed_whenHasBookmarks_showsBookmarks
methods.description: Verifies that bookmarks are displayed correctly when available.

methods.name: feed_whenRemovingBookmark_removesBookmark
methods.description: Ensures that removing a bookmark triggers the correct callback with the right ID.

methods.name: feed_whenHasNoBookmarks_showsEmptyState
methods.description: Checks that the empty state messages are shown when no bookmarks are present.

methods.name: feed_whenLifecycleStops_undoBookmarkedStateIsCleared
methods.description: Verifies that undo state is cleared when the lifecycle moves to stopped.
